name: yoiniwa
description: Yoiniwa (宵庭), a quiet offline reference board for Windows

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && set "REFCANVAS_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173" && concurrently -k --success command-electron -n vite,electron-ts,electron "vite --strictPort" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --noEmit --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
scripts.dev:test: npm run build:electron && set "REFCANVAS_CLEAN_TEST_SESSION=1" && set "REFCANVAS_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5174" && concurrently -k --success command-electron -n vite,electron-ts,electron "vite --port 5174 --strictPort" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --noEmit --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on http://localhost:5174 && electron ."
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:renderer && npm run typecheck:electron
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:dead-code && npm test
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:thumbnail-provider && npm run build:electron && vite build
scripts.start: npm run build:electron && vite build && electron .
scripts.smoke:dev: npm run build:electron && set "REFCANVAS_DEV_SMOKE=1" && set "REFCANVAS_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173" && concurrently -k --success command-electron -n vite,electron "vite --strictPort" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
scripts.smoke:perf: npm run build:electron && set "REFCANVAS_PERF_BENCH=1" && set "REFCANVAS_PERF_PHASE=before" && electron .
scripts.smoke:perf:after: npm run build:electron && set "REFCANVAS_PERF_BENCH=1" && set "REFCANVAS_PERF_PHASE=after" && electron .
scripts.smoke:project-zoom: npm run build && set "REFCANVAS_PROJECT_BENCH_PATH=%CD%\未命名画板.refcanvas" && electron .
scripts.smoke:project-zoom:extreme: npm run build && set "REFCANVAS_PROJECT_BENCH_PATH=%CD%\未命名画板.refcanvas" && set "REFCANVAS_PROJECT_BENCH_FOCUS_SCALE=16" && set "REFCANVAS_PROJECT_BENCH_PHASE=extreme" && electron .
scripts.smoke:real-images: npm run build:electron && set "REFCANVAS_REAL_IMAGE_TEST=1" && set "REFCANVAS_TEST_CACHE_ROOT=%TEMP%\refcanvas-real-images-%RANDOM%" && electron . --user-data-dir="%TEMP%\refcanvas-real-images-%RANDOM%"
scripts.smoke:thumbnail-fallback: npm run build:electron && set "REFCANVAS_REAL_IMAGE_TEST=1" && set "REFCANVAS_FORCE_THUMBNAIL_FAILURE=1" && set "REFCANVAS_TEST_CACHE_ROOT=%TEMP%\refcanvas-thumbnail-fallback-%RANDOM%" && electron . --user-data-dir="%TEMP%\refcanvas-thumbnail-fallback-%RANDOM%"
scripts.smoke:photoshop: npm run build && set "REFCANVAS_FAKE_PHOTOSHOP=synced" && set "REFCANVAS_PHOTOSHOP_SMOKE=1" && electron .
